examples.hanzi: 他在全国编程大赛中拿了奖。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài quánguó biānchéng dàsài zhōng ná le jiǎng.
examples.english: He won a prize in the national programming contest.

examples.hanzi: 学校下个月要举办歌唱大赛。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào xià ge yuè yào jǔbàn gēchàng dàsài.
examples.english: The school will hold a singing contest next month.

examples.hanzi: 他在同学们心中的形象一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài tóngxuémen xīnzhōng de xíngxiàng yìzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: His image in his classmates' eyes has always been good.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事里的老人形象非常生动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi lǐ de lǎorén xíngxiàng fēicháng shēngdòng.
examples.english: The old man in this story is vividly portrayed.

examples.hanzi: 孩子对新事物总是充满好奇。
examples.pinyin: Háizi duì xīn shìwù zǒngshì chōngmǎn hàoqí.
examples.english: Children are always curious about new things.

examples.hanzi: 随着时间过去，事物也在不断变化。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shíjiān guòqù, shìwù yě zài búduàn biànhuà.
examples.english: As time passes, things keep changing.

examples.hanzi: 这个袋子太小，装不下这么多东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàizi tài xiǎo, zhuāng bú xià zhème duō dōngxi.
examples.english: This bag is too small to hold so many things.

examples.hanzi: 请给我一个塑料袋子。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yí ge sùliào dàizi.
examples.english: Please give me a plastic bag.

examples.hanzi: 你再不回来，我就要发疯了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù huílái, wǒ jiù yào fāfēng le!
examples.english: If you don't come back soon, I'm going to go crazy!

examples.hanzi: 那只狗突然发疯一样地叫了起来。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu tūrán fāfēng yíyàng de jiào le qǐlái.
examples.english: The dog suddenly started barking like mad.

examples.hanzi: 除了苹果以外，我什么水果都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Chúle píngguǒ yǐwài, wǒ shénme shuǐguǒ dōu xǐhuan.
examples.english: Besides apples, I like every fruit.

examples.hanzi: 除了他以外，大家都到了。
examples.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu dào le.
examples.english: Everyone has arrived except him.

examples.hanzi: 他用绳子把箱子绑了起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shéngzi bǎ xiāngzi bǎng le qǐlái.
examples.english: He tied up the box with a rope.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在院子里跳绳子。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài yuànzi lǐ tiào shéngzi.
examples.english: The children are jumping rope in the yard.

examples.hanzi: 圣经是世界上发行量最大的书之一。
examples.pinyin: Shèngjīng shì shìjiè shang fāxíng liàng zuì dà de shū zhī yī.
examples.english: The Bible is one of the best-selling books in the world.

examples.hanzi: 这本圣经是奶奶留给我的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn Shèngjīng shì nǎinai liú gěi wǒ de.
examples.english: This Bible was left to me by my grandmother.

examples.hanzi: 明天下雨的可能性很大。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān xià yǔ de kěnéngxìng hěn dà.
examples.english: There is a high chance of rain tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我们不能排除这种可能性。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng páichú zhè zhǒng kěnéngxìng.
examples.english: We cannot rule out this possibility.

examples.hanzi: 钱花光了，我们别无选择，只能回家。
examples.pinyin: Qián huā guāng le, wǒmen biéwú xuǎnzé, zhǐ néng huí jiā.
examples.english: We ran out of money and had no choice but to go home.

examples.hanzi: 他别无选择，只好接受这份工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā biéwú xuǎnzé, zhǐhǎo jiēshòu zhè fèn gōngzuò.
examples.english: He had no choice but to accept this job.

examples.hanzi: 地板上有一些血迹，需要擦干净。
examples.pinyin: Dìbǎn shang yǒu yìxiē xuèjì, xūyào cā gānjìng.
examples.english: There are some bloodstains on the floor that need to be wiped off.

examples.hanzi: 衬衫上的血迹很难洗掉。
examples.pinyin: Chènshān shang de xuèjì hěn nán xǐ diào.
examples.english: The bloodstains on the shirt are hard to wash out.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶做的饭菜非常美味。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò de fàncài fēicháng měiwèi.
examples.english: The food Grandma makes is delicious.

examples.hanzi: 这里有许多当地的美味可以尝尝。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu xǔduō dāngdì de měiwèi kěyǐ chángchang.
examples.english: There are many local delicacies to try here.

examples.hanzi: 这家银行的总部在北京。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yínháng de zǒngbù zài Běijīng.
examples.english: This bank's headquarters is in Beijing.

examples.hanzi: 他被调到总部工作了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi diào dào zǒngbù gōngzuò le.
examples.english: He was transferred to work at the headquarters.

examples.hanzi: 阿姨，请问洗手间在哪里？
examples.pinyin: Āyí, qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Auntie, excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.hanzi: 我阿姨在医院当护士。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ āyí zài yīyuàn dāng hùshi.
examples.english: My aunt works as a nurse in the hospital.

examples.hanzi: 这个演员的表现很好，充分发挥了自己的才能。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǎnyuán de biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo, chōngfèn fāhuī le zìjǐ de cáinéng.
examples.english: This actor performed very well and made full use of his talent.

examples.hanzi: 考试时，别紧张，好好发挥。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shí, bié jǐnzhāng, hǎohāo fāhuī.
examples.english: Don't be nervous during the exam; just do your best.

examples.hanzi: 这些机密不能告诉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jīmì bù néng gàosu rènhé rén.
examples.english: You can't tell anyone these secrets.

examples.hanzi: 他泄露了公司的机密。
examples.pinyin: Tā xièlòu le gōngsī de jīmì.
examples.english: He leaked the company's confidential information.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影的主角是一位年轻的医生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔjué shì yí wèi niánqīng de yīshēng.
examples.english: The lead role in this movie is a young doctor.

examples.hanzi: 在这个故事里，小狗才是主角。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège gùshi lǐ, xiǎo gǒu cái shì zhǔjué.
examples.english: In this story, the puppy is the real protagonist.

examples.hanzi: 安娜每天早上都去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Ānnà měi tiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: Anna takes a walk in the park every morning.

examples.hanzi: 我下周要去看安娜，你想一起去吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu yào qù kàn Ānnà, nǐ xiǎng yìqǐ qù ma?
examples.english: I'm going to see Anna next week; do you want to come along?

examples.hanzi: 这座塔是为了纪念英雄而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò tǎ shì wèile jìniàn yīngxióng ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This tower was built to honor the heroes.

examples.hanzi: 这张照片是我们旅行的纪念。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì wǒmen lǚxíng de jìniàn.
examples.english: This photo is a memento of our trip.

examples.hanzi: 全球气候正在变暖。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú qìhòu zhèngzài biàn nuǎn.
examples.english: The global climate is getting warmer.

examples.hanzi: 这个游戏在全球有上亿玩家。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì zài quánqiú yǒu shàng yì wánjiā.
examples.english: This game has hundreds of millions of players worldwide.

examples.hanzi: 警察局离我家不远。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchájú lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn.
examples.english: The police station is not far from my home.

examples.hanzi: 我去警察局报了案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù jǐngchájú bào le àn.
examples.english: I went to the police station to report the case.

examples.hanzi: 他真倒霉，刚出门就下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhēn dǎoméi, gāng chū mén jiù xià yǔ le.
examples.english: He is so unlucky; it started raining just as he went out.

examples.hanzi: 我这几天特别倒霉，什么都不顺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān tèbié dǎoméi, shénme dōu bú shùn.
examples.english: I've been very unlucky these days and nothing goes right.

examples.hanzi: 他的胸部受了伤，需要住院治疗。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiōngbù shòu le shāng, xūyào zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
examples.english: His chest was injured and he needs hospital treatment.

examples.hanzi: 她说胸部有点疼，想做个检查。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō xiōngbù yǒudiǎn téng, xiǎng zuò ge jiǎnchá.
examples.english: She said her chest hurts a bit and wants to get checked.

examples.hanzi: 他对朋友非常忠诚。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì péngyou fēicháng zhōngchéng.
examples.english: He is very loyal to his friends.

examples.hanzi: 忠诚是婚姻中最重要的东西之一。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngchéng shì hūnyīn zhōng zuì zhòngyào de dōngxi zhī yī.
examples.english: Loyalty is one of the most important things in marriage.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸刮了胡子，看起来年轻多了。
examples.pinyin: Bàba guā le húzi, kàn qǐlái niánqīng duō le.
examples.english: Dad shaved his beard and looks much younger.

examples.hanzi: 那个男人留着很长的胡子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge nánrén liú zhe hěn cháng de húzi.
examples.english: That man has a very long beard.

examples.hanzi: 大哥，请问这条路能到火车站吗？
examples.pinyin: Dàgē, qǐngwèn zhè tiáo lù néng dào huǒchēzhàn ma?
examples.english: Brother, excuse me, does this road lead to the train station?

examples.hanzi: 我大哥比我大八岁，已经结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē bǐ wǒ dà bā suì, yǐjīng jiéhūn le.
examples.english: My eldest brother is eight years older than me and is already married.

examples.hanzi: 这个小妞很聪明，什么都一学就会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoniū hěn cōngmíng, shénme dōu yì xué jiù huì.
examples.english: This little girl is clever and picks up everything quickly.

examples.hanzi: 隔壁的小妞今年才五岁。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de xiǎoniū jīnnián cái wǔ suì.
examples.english: The little girl next door is only five this year.

examples.hanzi: 他很喜欢打橄榄球。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan dǎ gǎnlǎnqiú.
examples.english: He loves playing rugby.

examples.hanzi: 这个橄榄球是皮做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎnlǎnqiú shì pí zuò de.
examples.english: This rugby ball is made of leather.

examples.hanzi: 酒精进入体内会影响判断力。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔjīng jìnrù tǐnèi huì yǐngxiǎng pànduàn lì.
examples.english: Alcohol in the body affects your judgment.

examples.hanzi: 多运动可以增加体内的能量。
examples.pinyin: Duō yùndòng kěyǐ zēngjiā tǐnèi de néngliàng.
examples.english: Exercising more can increase energy in your body.

examples.hanzi: 你相信外星人真的存在吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiāngxìn wàixīngrén zhēnde cúnzài ma?
examples.english: Do you believe aliens really exist?

examples.hanzi: 孩子们画了一个绿色的外星人。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen huà le yí ge lǜsè de wàixīngrén.
examples.english: The kids drew a green alien.

examples.hanzi: 虽然很累，但毕竟这是我们的工作。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn bìjìng zhè shì wǒmen de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Although it's tiring, this is our job after all.

examples.hanzi: 你别怪他，毕竟他也不是故意的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié guài tā, bìjìng tā yě bú shì gùyì de.
examples.english: Don't blame him; he didn't do it on purpose after all.

examples.hanzi: 医院的走廊里有很多人在等候。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn de zǒuláng lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén zài děnghòu.
examples.english: There are many people waiting in the hospital corridor.

examples.hanzi: 请不要在走廊里大声说话。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài zǒuláng lǐ dàshēng shuō huà.
examples.english: Please don't talk loudly in the hallway.

examples.hanzi: 他在墙上画了一幅画。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qiángshang huà le yì fú huà.
examples.english: He painted a picture on the wall.

examples.hanzi: 一只小猫坐在墙上晒太阳。
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī xiǎo māo zuò zài qiángshang shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: A kitten sits on top of the wall sunbathing.

examples.hanzi: 这种病的主要症状是发烧和咳嗽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìng de zhǔyào zhèngzhuàng shì fāshāo hé késou.
examples.english: The main symptoms of this illness are fever and coughing.

examples.hanzi: 吃药以后，症状慢慢消失了。
examples.pinyin: Chī yào yǐhòu, zhèngzhuàng mànmàn xiāoshī le.
examples.english: After taking medicine, the symptoms slowly disappeared.

examples.hanzi: 当初我们都没想到会这样。
examples.pinyin: Dāngchū wǒmen dōu méi xiǎngdào huì zhèyàng.
examples.english: At the time, none of us expected it to turn out this way.

examples.hanzi: 他当初是一个小店员，现在已经是经理了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāngchū shì yí ge xiǎo diànyuán, xiànzài yǐjīng shì jīnglǐ le.
examples.english: He started out as a small shop assistant and is now a manager.

examples.hanzi: 我们要遵守社会道德。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnshǒu shèhuì dàodé.
examples.english: We must follow social morals.

examples.hanzi: 他是个很有道德的人，从不占别人便宜。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge hěn yǒu dàodé de rén, cóng bú zhàn biéren piányi.
examples.english: He is a very ethical person who never takes advantage of others.

examples.hanzi: 孩子终于睡着了，请小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhōngyú shuìzháo le, qǐng xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn.
examples.english: The child has finally fallen asleep, so please keep it down.

examples.hanzi: 昨晚太吵了，我一直没睡着。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn tài chǎo le, wǒ yìzhí méi shuìzháo.
examples.english: It was too noisy last night and I couldn't fall asleep.

examples.hanzi: 她哭得很伤心，我只好去安慰她。
examples.pinyin: Tā kū de hěn shāngxīn, wǒ zhǐhǎo qù ānwèi tā.
examples.english: She cried so sadly that I had to go comfort her.

examples.hanzi: 你的话给了我很大的安慰。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de huà gěi le wǒ hěn dà de ānwèi.
examples.english: Your words gave me great comfort.

examples.hanzi: 这个系列的电影一共有五部。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xìliè de diànyǐng yígòng yǒu wǔ bù.
examples.english: This series of movies has five films in total.

examples.hanzi: 学校组织了一系列有趣的活动。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zǔzhī le yíxìliè yǒuqù de huódòng.
examples.english: The school organized a series of interesting activities.

examples.hanzi: 这个孩子有着一双明亮的大眼睛。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǒuzhe yì shuāng míngliàng de dà yǎnjing.
examples.english: This child has a pair of bright big eyes.

examples.hanzi: 他有着丰富的工作经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe fēngfù de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
examples.english: He has rich work experience.

examples.hanzi: 多运动，肌肉才会变得结实。
examples.pinyin: Duō yùndòng, jīròu cái huì biàn de jiēshi.
examples.english: Exercise more and your muscles will become firm.

examples.hanzi: 跑完步后，我的腿部肌肉很酸。
examples.pinyin: Pǎo wán bù hòu, wǒ de tuǐbù jīròu hěn suān.
examples.english: After running, my leg muscles are sore.

examples.hanzi: 路上小心，多保重！
examples.pinyin: Lùshang xiǎoxīn, duō bǎozhòng!
examples.english: Be careful on the road and take care of yourself!

examples.hanzi: 你工作那么忙，要保重身体。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gōngzuò nàme máng, yào bǎozhòng shēntǐ.
examples.english: You are so busy at work; take care of your health.

examples.hanzi: 这位科学家获得了诺贝尔奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā huòdé le Nuòbèi'ěr jiǎng.
examples.english: This scientist won a Nobel Prize.

examples.hanzi: 科学家们正在研究新的能源。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zhèngzài yánjiū xīn de néngyuán.
examples.english: Scientists are researching new sources of energy.

examples.hanzi: 天快要黑了，我们回家吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān kuàiyào hēi le, wǒmen huí jiā ba.
examples.english: It's getting dark; let's go home.

examples.hanzi: 我快要毕业了，正在找工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kuàiyào bìyè le, zhèngzài zhǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: I'm about to graduate and am looking for a job.

examples.hanzi: 他的突然离开让大家都很震惊。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tūrán líkāi ràng dàjiā dōu hěn zhènjīng.
examples.english: His sudden departure shocked everyone.

examples.hanzi: 她震惊地看着眼前的一切。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhènjīng de kàn zhe yǎnqián de yíqiè.
examples.english: She stared at everything in front of her in shock.

examples.hanzi: 这个城市有很多娱乐场所。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu hěn duō yúlè chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: This city has many entertainment venues.

examples.hanzi: 看电影是一种很好的娱乐方式。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de yúlè fāngshì.
examples.english: Watching movies is a good form of entertainment.

examples.hanzi: 他们不愿意再忍受，决定反抗。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bú yuànyì zài rěnshòu, juédìng fǎnkàng.
examples.english: They were unwilling to endure it any longer and decided to resist.

examples.hanzi: 小孩有时候会反抗父母的安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái yǒu shíhou huì fǎnkàng fùmǔ de ānpái.
examples.english: Children sometimes rebel against their parents' arrangements.

examples.hanzi: 别怕，那只是一个噩梦。
examples.pinyin: Bié pà, nà zhǐshì yí ge èmèng.
examples.english: Don't be afraid; it was only a nightmare.

examples.hanzi: 考试的前一天，我常常做噩梦。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì de qián yì tiān, wǒ chángcháng zuò èmèng.
examples.english: The day before an exam, I often have nightmares.

examples.hanzi: 她是一个心灵手巧的人，什么都会做。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge xīnlíng shǒuqiǎo de rén, shénme dōu huì zuò.
examples.english: She is a clever and skilled person who can make anything.

examples.hanzi: 这本书触动了很多读者的心灵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū chùdòng le hěn duō dúzhě de xīnlíng.
examples.english: This book touched the hearts of many readers.

examples.hanzi: 你付出了这么多，这笔奖金是你应得的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fùchū le zhème duō, zhè bǐ jiǎngjīn shì nǐ yīngdé de.
examples.english: You put in so much effort; this bonus is what you deserve.

examples.hanzi: 他犯了错，这是他应得的惩罚。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàn le cuò, zhè shì tā yīngdé de chéngfá.
examples.english: He made a mistake, and this is the punishment he deserves.
